## About
West University Wellness is a family chiropractic office on Bellaire Blvd. Our staff provides holistic, effective, proactive health care for you and your entire family, and we like to teach our patients and our community about chiropractic, acupuncture, massage, craniosacral work, exercise and nutrition.
Pregnancy and pediatric chiropractic is a big part of what we do. Dr. Caroline Long founded the practice, and she works alongside Dr. Ploy Chotiratkul, Dr. Hanieh Hosseini, Dr. Menka Patel and Dr. Jill Burk. All of our doctors are Webster-certified, and our massage therapists Angie and Savannah-Morgan are certified in prenatal massage.
Our care is meant to give you a better quality of life without medication or invasive procedures. We're rated 4.9 from 547 Google reviews, and we'd love to meet you.

## Services
- Chiropractic: We don't use the same adjustment on everyone. Our doctors choose from techniques like Diversified, Activator, Thompson, Flexion-Distraction and Logan Basic to fit you.
- Pregnancy: We modify our adjusting techniques to fit each stage of your pregnancy, including the Webster Technique for pelvic balance.
- Pediatrics: Gentle care for babies and kids, including cranial work for children with torticollis and plagiocephaly.
- Massage Therapy: Angie and Savannah-Morgan offer prenatal massage. One reviewer said they have the right pillows and great knowledge.
- Labor Preparation: Choose any of the four parts: a chiropractic adjustment, massage by the doctor, acupuncture, or a Labor Prep massage with our massage therapists.
- Post-Partum: Care after birth to help you recover and to help prepare your body for future births.
- Acupuncture: Acupuncture and dry-needling alongside chiropractic care.
- Nutrition: Nutritional counseling with Dr. Long as part of your treatment plan.

## FAQ
Q: Does the Webster Technique move my baby?
A: No. The adjustments are done on the mother, not the baby, to give the baby more room to move.

Q: Can I bring my child?
A: Yes. One parent wrote that her son loved his appointment with Dr. Long and was ready to go back.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday and Wednesday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 2:30 to 6:30 PM. Tuesday 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Thursday 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM and 2:00 to 4:00 PM. Friday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 2:30 to 5:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Call us, book online, or send us a message through the site and we'll get back to you.
